headline_verdict: The frozen heldout arithmetic and Python ring recurrence are reproducible, but M142 RTL-cycle equivalence is not established. Keep 2.594690240x and 1.812225612x strictly as same-clock module-cycle-model ratios.

findings.title: Zero-work endpoint recurrence contradicts the release contract and M142 state machine
findings.evidence: The Python recurrence releases all 300 zero-correction units without a correction launch/completion and gives all 1332 zero-PWP units zero PWP duration. The contract says only matching correction completion frees a bank, while M142 always transitions PWP -> WAIT_CORRECTION -> CORRECTION -> FREE and cannot accept a same-edge launch/done.
findings.impact: The reported cycles are not cycle-equivalent to the current M142 ready/valid interface, even though a one-cycle zero-endpoint sensitivity changes final B4 by only 18 cycles under this recurrence.
findings.required_fix: Choose and freeze one contract: either add explicit zero-work bypass RTL plus VCS assertions, or charge legal launch/done latency for zero-work PWP/correction endpoints in the model. Recompute and independently replay.

findings.title: The 160 outer window barriers are not represented by an M142 interface contract
findings.evidence: The cycle model blocks PWP/correction service across every partition-431 flush/commit barrier and permits bounded producer lookahead of at most B banks. M142 has no record/window barrier, commit request, or commit-done port; its row_window_end closes only one descriptor bank.
findings.impact: Correct barrier behavior currently depends on unstated external pwp_ready gating and commit control, so the standalone RTL cannot realize the exact recurrence by itself.
findings.required_fix: Add an explicit outer-boundary/commit handshake wrapper, or publish a cycle-exact driver contract and VCS replay proving zero service crossings and bounded lookahead.

findings.title: Exact sequence and completion identity are not closed at the RTL boundary
findings.evidence: The model assumes 69120 ordered record/window/partition units. M142 does not check row_id progression or exact row count, and its PWP/correction completion interfaces return only bank plus a default 16-bit tag; the internal 32-bit sequence is not echoed. The frozen extent exceeds the 65536-value default tag space.
findings.impact: Drop/duplicate/reorder and tag-wrap/ABA attacks are not excluded by the present interface or SVA, so exact heldout ordering is a producer assumption rather than verified module behavior.
findings.required_fix: Expose an epoch/sequence token on both endpoint request and completion paths and add row-count/order plus wrap/stale-response VCS attacks.

findings.title: Ring allocation in Python differs from lowest-free allocation in RTL
findings.evidence: Python selects index modulo BANKS; M142 selects the lowest-numbered free bank. An independent lowest-free sensitivity happened to reproduce B2/B3/B4 totals exactly on this heldout stream.
findings.impact: No frozen numerical impact was observed, but schedule-level equivalence is unproved.
findings.required_fix: Use the RTL allocator in the production recurrence or assert and prove allocator-policy invariance.

findings.title: B2 is a model-only point but the architecture list does not say so
findings.evidence: M143 lists bounded banks [2,3,4], while M142 fatals unless BANKS is 3 or 4.
findings.impact: B2 can be mistaken for an implemented controller configuration.
findings.required_fix: Label B2 analytical-only in the contract/result or enable and verify BANKS=2.

findings.title: Signed row contents are not reconstructed by the analyzer
findings.evidence: The analyzer rebuilds source masks and popcounts but never constructs row_negate_mask, although M142 consumes separate source and negate masks.
findings.impact: Cycle counts are unaffected, but an exact signed raw-row interface claim is not independently supported.
findings.required_fix: Export/reconstruct negate masks and bind a signed descriptor digest to a VCS replay.

findings.title: Result exact_work omits correction_service_tokens
findings.evidence: The contract freezes 124730596 correction tokens and each raw model contains the field, but the top-level result exact_work object omits it.
findings.impact: A top-level conservation ledger consumer can silently miss one dominant workload.
findings.required_fix: Add correction_service_tokens to exact_work and preserve byte-pinned provenance.

findings.title: Production recurrence is imported from a prior review artifact
findings.evidence: M143 loads IndependentOverlap from the M141 independent-review script rather than defining a production-owned recurrence. This audit independently reimplemented it and matched exactly.
findings.impact: The numbers are reproducible, but production lineage and ownership are unnecessarily coupled to reviewer code.
findings.required_fix: Move the corrected recurrence into a production module and retain the review implementation only as a differential oracle.
